data.title: Amended income tax assessment for 2022 (no change in tax)
data.summary: Finanzamt Neu-Musterdorf sent an amended 2022 income tax assessment dated 17 December 2024. The tax stays at €6,918.00, so there is no additional payment and no refund.
data.explanation: The tax office changed your 2022 income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) because your employer submitted changed data. The tax amount is the same as before (€6,918.00), so you owe nothing and get nothing back. If you disagree with the assessment, you may file an objection (Einspruch). The app shows the deadline for this. Otherwise nothing needs to be done, but keep the letter with your tax records. A tax adviser can help if you are unsure.
data.tax_note: Amended income tax assessment for 2022; keep it with your tax records.

items.title: Objection period for amended 2022 assessment
items.action: If you disagree with the assessment, file an objection (Einspruch) with the tax office by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: After the deadline the assessment becomes final and can no longer be challenged in the usual way.
